prompt:
Produce the implementation artifact for a two-site VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 architecture; this is an architecture deliverable, not an explanatory report. Implement only Main.java. TestMain.java calls Main.architectureJson() and Main.researchConsultedJson(), writing their UTF-8 results to build/architecture.json and build/research-consulted.json. Use only the Java standard library.

Before coding, research Broadcom's published compatibility, interoperability, upgrade-path, and VCF 9.1 documentation. Research both the supported greenfield component combination and the supplied estate's path to 9.1. Main.researchConsultedJson() must return a JSON array recording the sources consulted; each entry must contain title, url, retrievedAt, and supports strings.

Main.architectureJson() must return one JSON object conforming to fixtures/architecture_artifact.schema.json. Populate it as a machine-readable design for these fixed requirements:
- Deploy a greenfield VCF 9.1.0.0 stretched management domain across data sites CHI-A and CHI-B, with exactly four data hosts at each site. Each host supplies 64 physical cores, 1,024 GiB RAM, and 15.36 TB raw vSAN capacity. The management platform must retain at least 220 cores, 3,072 GiB RAM, and 45.0 TB raw capacity after loss of either data site.
- Set vSAN failuresToTolerate to 2. The architecture must make host placement and derived total and surviving-site capacity explicit.
- Place exactly one vSAN witness appliance at QCY-W, a third, witness-only site and independent fault domain. It must not be listed as a data host or as providing data capacity. Design for 3 ms CHI-A/CHI-B round-trip latency and 12 ms maximum round-trip latency from either data site to QCY-W.
- Use the supplied identifiers, addressing, and required network types from fixtures/design_inputs.json. Include an SddcSpec under greenfield.sddcSpec that conforms to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. This is a new deployment: useExistingDeployment must be false wherever present. The component targets must be a complete supported VCF 9.1 greenfield BOM.
- For the separate existing estate in fixtures/estate_inventory.json, include existingEstateMigration as an ordered migration plan. It must name every inventory component exactly once with componentId, componentName, currentVersion, targetVersion, order, and gates. Use supported version pairs, order, and compatibility/component-version gates from the researched path. Do not omit unchanged-looking components and do not invent inventory components.

Do not modify TestMain.java, tests/, fixtures/, specifications/, third_party/, or .gitignore. Run python3 tests/verify.py for acceptance.
